item.description:
## New Features
- Use the arrows beside the date picker in Overview, Records, and Speed to browse earlier periods. - Redesigned the Speed page. - The digits in the floating counter roll more smoothly as small increases carry over. - Release notes for future in-app updates follow the language you choose in Tokenory.
## Fixes
- Fixed an undercount when Codex omitted context compaction from its cumulative token totals. - Fixed duplicate Devin CLI usage when the same request appeared more than once in a session log.
